parent_objective: audit bounded retarget smoke before measured intervention or candidate materialization
blocked_by: retarget smoke produced useful near-boundary traces plus failures that need audit
supersedes: direct measured intervention or candidate materialization from M1514 without auditing failures

public_gates: M1515 must audit M1514 retarget margins labels and failures
M1515 must decide whether measured intervention design is admissible for any subset
M1515 must identify source-family or retarget-mode repairs
M1515 must not materialize candidates or export a training corpus
M1515 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not materialize candidates during the audit
do not claim self-identification from retargeted near-boundary traces

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1514 retarget smoke to choose measured intervention subset or retarget repair
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: retarget result audit and next-route decision only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if retarget artifacts are missing or malformed
stop if audit ignores reset failures or pre-decision collision
stop if audit treats near-boundary traces as self-identification evidence
stop if audit routes directly to training or corpus export
fallback_plan: if near-boundary subset is usable, route to measured intervention design
if failures dominate, route to source-retarget repair
if traces are too hard or too easy, route to capped retarget calibration

admission_evidence: M1514 reduced global min margin to -0.042 and produced 39 near-boundary proxy rows while keeping guardrails false
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up measured-intervention or retarget-repair manifest
next_stage_criteria: candidate materialization remains blocked or is routed through measured intervention design

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1515 audits scenario retargeting only; near-boundary success or collision is not history necessity evidence.
history_necessity_tests: audit whether M1514 traces are suitable for future wrong/delayed/current-tiled intervention continuations
do not claim history necessity until intervention margin gaps are measured
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1514 bounded public retarget traces only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If retarget traces are too hard or sampling failures dominate, route to repair rather than materializing weak candidates.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1514 retarget smoke produced enough near-boundary signal to audit whether a measured intervention subset should be designed next.
success_criteria: audit summarizes retarget margins labels failures and guardrails
audit explicitly decides measured-intervention-admit retarget-repair or stop
audit keeps candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input change corpus export and self-ID claims blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats near-boundary traces as self-ID evidence
audit starts candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout or corpus export

repair_needed: T4 source families remain high-margin and aeb_feasible
drift_required_focus reset sampling fails for four source families

decision_rule: M1515 passes if it audits retarget trace quality and chooses the next route without materializing candidates or claiming self-identification.
